Sam G: Quick share — ran an sm95 autotune sweep focused on quantized kernel picks (INT8 / INT4 / FP8) across seqlen buckets. Short summary attached below.
Lia M: Nice, do you have the numbers by seqlen buckets?
Pranav K: pasted perf samples from the job (microbench 1 thread, 1 request):

```
sm95 | seq<=64  | INT8  = 4.2ms | INT4 = 3.8ms | FP8 = 3.6ms
sm95 | 65-512   | INT8  = 12.4ms| INT4 = 10.1ms| FP8 = 9.7ms
sm95 | 513-2048 | INT8  = 86ms  | INT4 = 72ms  | FP8 = 68ms
KV-cold penalty (longseq, FP8): +18ms median when kvcache not warmed (noticed in 10% samples)
```
Toni R: Huh, FP8 looks fastest raw but I vaguely remember a regression in production for long sequences when cache cold — this matches that. We saw tail latency spikes during canary last week. :thinking_face:
Sam G: Right — profiling shows FP8 kernel triggers a different memory pattern that competes with kvcache warmup for large seqs. Short sequences prefer FP8/INT4, long sequences prefer INT4 for stability.
Lia M: So what are you proposing for autotune rules? Simple seq_thresholds? dynamic fallback?
Pranav K: Proposal in config form:

```
runtime.autotune:
  arch: sm95
  quant_profiles:
    - quant: INT4
      seq_threshold: 512
      kv_warmup_ms: 60
    - quant: FP8
      seq_threshold: 1024
      kv_warmup_ms: 120
  hysteresis: 1.2  # require 20% perf win to switch
  warmup_samples: 8
```
Toni R: I like adding kv_warmup_ms and hysteresis. Suggest lowering FP8 priority for seqlen in [513,1024] when kvcache hit rate < 80% (to avoid tail latencies).
Sam G: Agreed. I'll add a metric gate: if kv_hit_rate < 0.8 then prefer INT4 even if FP8 microbench is slightly faster. That should reduce regression surface.
perf-bot: Canary scheduled: canary/quant-sm95-2026-03-17 -> 5% traffic, PR #4321 linked: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 :rocket:
Lia M: Can you run the longer 10k-sample trace perf run? Need p95 and p99 for both cold and warm cache.
Pranav K: On it — kicking off trace-runner job now, will drop flamegraphs here when done. Expect results ~2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Sam G: Thanks. After trace-run results we can merge the PR and ship canary. If p99 improves or no regression we'll escalate rollout to 25%.
Lia M: :thumbsup: keep an eye on cost delta — FP8 increases memory pressure on sm95 which might affect throughput, so include tokens/sec metric.
Pranav K: noted. I'll include tokens/sec and gpu-mem-alloc graphs. Also adding an integration smoke to detect kv_warmup regressions automatically.
Toni R: Awesome. If this reduces the longseq tail we win.
Sam G: Closing loop — PR #4321 will include the seq_threshold changes + metric gate + unit test for kvcache fallback. I'll update the canary thread after the 2h run. :party_parrot:
